system.description:
In place of one of your attacks made by the Attack action, you spend a superiority to strengthen an allies power.

Target an allied creature within 30 feet of you. The next attack made or jutsu cast is heightened. They can either gain the benefit of your Jack of All: Combat or Jack of All: Control. Your choice.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.

roll.note: In place of an attack of the Attack action: an ally within 30 feet's next attack or jutsu gets Jack of All's Combat or Control benefit (your choice).
